From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@brightlayer.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor intake — BrightLayer / Redwood onboarding questions

Hi Diego / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this — BrightLayer is ready to move forward with Redwood for inference serving and we want to get procurement and vendor setup completed this month. I attached our vendor worksheet (BrightLayer_Vendor_Info.xlsx) with the billing details and W-9. A few items we need clarity on from your side to keep legal & finance happy:

- Typical lead time for PO issuance once the SOW is signed (we usually operate on net-45).
- Any vendor onboarding forms you require (tax, security questionnaire, bank details).
- Preferred contact for commercial/PO questions (name + email).
- Success criteria for the initial activation (e.g., test keys, perf target, billing milestones).

Can we schedule a short 30-min intake this week to align MAP items and checklist owners? We are available Thu 7/2 between 10–12 PT or Fri 7/3 morning.

Appreciate it —
Karen Liu
Procurement Manager
BrightLayer Systems
karen.liu@brightlayer.com
procurement@brightlayer.com

Attachment: BrightLayer_Vendor_Info.xlsx (spreadsheet, 46KB)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor intake — BrightLayer / Redwood onboarding questions

Hi Karen — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the worksheet.

We'd like to run a short "vendor activation sprint" to get you live with a minimal friction runway. Proposed agenda (30 min):

1) Introductions & stakeholders (5 min)
2) Procurement checklist review (forms, tax, payment terms) (10 min)
3) Mutual Action Plan (MAP) & timeline (10 min)
4) Next steps / owners / calendar invites (5 min)

Availability from our side: Thu 7/2 10:30–11:00 PT or 11:30–12:00 PT; Fri 7/3 09:00–09:30 PT. If none of those work, propose 30-min windows and we'll accommodate.

Attached are two documents to speed the intake: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (standard vendor form) and a MAP_template.xlsx you can review. Can you confirm who from BrightLayer should be on the call (finance, procurement, project owner)? Also flag any mandatory contract terms (e.g., net-45) so we can loop in Legal early.

Internal notes for the call (Marissa / Rishi): please be prepared to speak to PO timing and our invoicing process; Rishi, please note any legal constraints on net-45 vs net-30.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Head of Strategic Partnerships (Operations)
Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf, 22KB); MAP_template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)

Looking forward —
Karen

We will circulate a concise MAP during the call and capture owners against each checklist item. Diego / Rishi — after the call I'll kick off the ledger entry and finance will request the PO number once SOW is approved.

See you Thu.
